title: Incomplete state space: nbands != nbasis
symptom: The state-space gate reports nstates != nbasis (band_out state count differs from the physical LCAO basis dimension).
root_cause: nbands is set below the full LCAO basis dimension, truncating the screening space and underconverging the GW self-energy. This is often a silent configuration error in INPUT_scf / INPUT_nscf.
minimal_fix: Raise ABACUS nbands to the full basis dimension (nbands == nbasis). If that is too expensive, keep nbands >= nbasis and leave the state-space gate NOT_EVALUATED rather than silently truncating.
validation: Re-run the stage.state_space.nbands_vs_nbasis gate: it passes when nstates == nbasis.
avoid: Silently truncating nbands below nbasis; a truncated state space corrupts EXX/GW and is a common cause of abnormal result jumps.
source: abacus-librpa-debug skill ('abnormal result jumps: check nbands against basis-size conventions'); oh-my-librpa gw-route.
